name: Cancha Viva - Reporte a Arte Generativo

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "You are an art director for Cancha Viva, a digital activism platform against racism in football. Analyze this incident report and respond ONLY with valid JSON (no extra text, no markdown) with exactly these keys: tipo_incidente, intensidad, resumen_publico, prompt_artistico.

For prompt_artistico: write a vivid, cinematic image generation prompt in English for a powerful fine-art painting. The artwork must:
- Convey the emotional weight of the incident AND the hope of resistance against it
- Use symbolic visual metaphors (fractured light, roots breaking concrete, birds escaping cages, flames and water, shattered chains, blooming in darkness)
- Specify a strong color palette that carries emotional meaning (e.g. oppressive dark indigo giving way to warm gold light)
- Reference a painterly style (e.g. expressive brushstrokes like Basquiat, chiaroscuro lighting, bold impasto texture, watercolor bleed)
- Describe composition and mood with precision
- Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO logos, NO faces, NO recognizable people in the image
- The art must speak through pure visual language

Incident report: {{$json.descripcion}}. Location: {{$json.lugar}}. Type: {{$json.tipoIncidente}}"
    }
  ]
}
